visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Enthusiastic fans, primarily young women with joyful expressions and smiling eyes, hold up intricate placards in a dimly lit arena illuminated by vibrant blue and red stage lights. The signs are highly detailed, featuring hand-drawn anime characters representing e-sports players and stylized text like 'FW' and 'ZHAN'. A fan in a purple headband smiles warmly while presenting a purple board covered in sketches. (2) A rapid montage showcases a wide variety of fan-made art, including a sign with a cute cartoon car and another decorated with white lace, frills, and ribbons surrounding a player's photograph. The fans are seated in tiered red stadium chairs, waving their boards and gesturing excitedly toward the camera. The environment remains a dark event hall with scattered high-intensity artificial light. (3) The visual focus shifts to a specific large yellow placard held by a female fan. It contains a professional-quality pencil and marker sketch of a male player with glasses, surrounded by colorful, graffiti-style explosive text. The camera performs a slow digital zoom to highlight the artistic detail of the 'Wolf King' portrait against the backdrop of red arena seating. (4) A large crowd of fans raises their hands and placards in unison, cheering during a high-energy climax of the event. A fan in the foreground holds a large white plush toy shaped like a cartoon wolf mascot wearing a team jersey. The background is filled with the blurred figures of hundreds of other attendees in the dark, atmospheric stadium environment.
